cex._note: Fallback when CeX's main API is Cloudflare-blocked. Grab the two PUBLIC keys from browser dev tools on uk.webuy.com - see README 'Fixing CeX'. If the keys are rejected by algolia.net directly, set algoliaHost to search.webuy.io (CeX proxies its search) and algoliaIndex to the indexName from the request payload.

ai._providers: ollama = free, local (install from ollama.com, then: ollama pull llama3.1:8b). openai = any OpenAI-compatible API incl. free tiers: Groq (baseUrl https://api.groq.com/openai, model llama-3.3-70b-versatile), Gemini (baseUrl https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai, model gemini-2.5-flash), OpenRouter free models. anthropic = Claude API, paid, best quality (apiKey from console.anthropic.com, model claude-opus-4-8).
